verdict.rationale: Mercury's ReadMe-hosted API Reference has a live "Try It!" request runner on every endpoint page. Each page also offers generated code samples in Shell, Node, Ruby, PHP and Python, a Bearer credentials field, per-endpoint parameters and response schemas. A safe sandbox base URL with dummy data, plus llms.txt and Markdown/OpenAPI exports, make the reference usable for agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the Try It runner works, and documentation that the runner can target the sandbox environment (common OpenAPI spec paths also returned 404 when probed).
